x-k-k1-01.title: Iyiphi isiqondiso esiholela endaweni yokupaka?
x-k-k1-01.goal: Funda izimpawu ezintathu zomgwaqo ezimfushane, uhlanganise amagama nomcibisholo nophawu olufanekiselwe, bese wahlulela ukuthi yimuphi ongeniselwa ngempela umvakashi ukuthi apake; vikela isahlulelo ngokumelene nokufunda kwengxenye komngane.
x-k-k1-01.material:
Umvakashi uyashayela esikoleni futhi ufuna ukushiya imoto ihora elilodwa. Izimpawu ezintathu ziyabonakala (azikho izithombe, ngakho zichazwe ngamagama).

Isiqondiso A: izinhlamvu ezimhlophe '주차 금지' ebhodini elibomvu. Indilinga ebomvu enomugqa ocijile iwela isithombe esincane semoto. Sibekwe ocingweni lwesikole.
Isiqondiso B: ibhodi eliluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, izinhlamvu ezimhlophe '방문자 주차장' nomcibisholo okhomba kwesokudla. Simi eceleni komgwaqo.
Isiqondiso C: ibhodi eliluhlaza, izinhlamvu ezimhlophe '주차장 출구' nomcibisholo okhomba emuva emgwaqweni. Sixhume phezu kwendlela emincane lapho izimoto zihamba ziphuma khona.

Amagama: 주차(장) = indawo yokupaka; 방문자 = umvakashi; 입구 = ukungena; 출구 = ukuphuma.
x-k-k1-01.prereq.1: Uyazi ukuthi umcibisholo esiqondisweni ukhombisa indlela yokuhamba
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.prompt: Yisiphi isiqondiso umvakashi okufanele asilandele ukuze apake?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi isiqondiso ngasinye sithini ngamagama, nokuthi uphawu noma umcibisholo wengeza ini.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Buza kusiqondiso ngasinye: sithumela imoto ngaphakathi, ngaphandle, noma ndawo?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.a: U-주차장 usesiqondisweni, kodwa ligama elilodwa kuphela kwamabili. Hlola ukuthi igama lesibili nomcibisholo kusho ini ngendlela izimoto ezihamba ngayo.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.b: Lesi siqondiso sinalo no-주차. Bheka indilinga ebomvu enomugqa: uphawu olunjalo luvame ukukutshela ini?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.c: Uhlanganise igama lomvakashi, igama lokupaka nomcibisholo. Yileyo ndlela isiqondiso esifundwa ngayo sonke.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.o.d: Isiqondiso B noma Isiqondiso C; bobabili bathi 주차장 futhi banomcibisholo
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.d: Bobabili bathi 주차장 futhi banomcibisholo, kodwa hlola ukuthi igama lesinye le-Isiqondiso C nesiqondiso somcibisholo wawo kusho ini.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.explain: Isiqondiso B singesabavakashi, siqamba indawo yokupaka futhi sinikeza isiqondiso. Isiqondiso A sinegama lokuqala elifanayo kodwa sithwele uphawu lokuvimbela. Isiqondiso C siqamba indawo yokupaka nakho, kodwa u-출구 usho ukuphuma, ngakho sikhomba lapho izimoto zihamba khona.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.prompt: Umngane uthi: 'Sign C has 주차장 in it, so let's drive in through there.' Phendula umngane wakho ngemisho eyodwa noma emibili yesiNgisi, usebenzisa lokho isiqondiso esikushoyo ngempela.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Yiliphi igama le-Isiqondiso C elihlukile kweleka-B?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Izimoto ziya kuphi endleleni enesiqondiso sokuphuma?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngisebenzise igama lesiqondiso njengobufakazi, hhayi umbono wami kuphela?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngisho ukuthi isiqondiso sisetshenziselwa ini (ukuphuma) nokuthi sidinga ini esikhundleni saso?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Umngane wami angazi ukuthi abheke kuphi okulandelayo?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.0: Isiqondiso C sithi 출구, okusho ukuphuma. Izimoto ziphuma lapho, ngakho kufanele sifune indawo yokungena, njengomcibisholo ku-Isiqondiso B.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.modelNote.0: Siqamba igama eliyinhloko nendawo yokungena engekho.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.1: U-주차장 uyingxenye kuphela. Igama elilodwa, u-출구, lisitshela ukuthi izimoto ziyaphuma lapho, ngakho besizoshayela ngendlela engalungile.

x-k-k1-07.title: Ungangena nini emtatsheni wezincwadi?
x-k-k1-07.goal: Funda uphawu olunemigqa eminingi, nquma ukuthi yimiphi imigqa ebalulekile ngosuku oluthile, bese uthola izikhathi eziningana zokufika ezihambisana nayo yonke.
x-k-k1-07.material:
Uphawu emnyango womtapo wezincwadi (umugqa owodwa ngomgqa ngamunye):

도서관
오전 9시 ~ 오후 6시
낮 12시 ~ 1시 쉬어요
일요일 쉬어요

Amagama: 오전 = a.m.; 오후 = p.m.; 낮 = emini; 쉬어요 = (uyaphumula); ~ ifundwa ngokuthi 'ukuya ku-' (kusuka ... kuya ...). Ufuna ukuvakasha ngoLwesithathu.
x-k-k1-07.thinking.0: Ukukhetha ukuthi yimiphi imigqa yophawu esebenzayo
x-k-k1-07.thinking.1: Ukuthola izixazululo eziningana ngaphansi kwemikhawulo emibili
x-k-k1-07.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukuthi kungani ezinye izikhathi ziyehluleka
x-k-k1-07.prereq.1: Wazi ukuthi 오전 ekuseni futhi 오후 entambama
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.prompt: Yimiphi imigqa yophawu ebalulekile uma uvakashela ngoLwesithathu? Khetha yonke efanele.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Umugqa owodwa igama; owodwa mayelana nolunye usuku.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.a: Leli yigama lendawo; alikhawuli isikhathi sakho.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.b: Ubone ukuthi lo mugqa unikeza amahora osuku olujwayelekile.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.c: Ubone ukuthi indawo iyayeka isikhashana phakathi nosuku.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.d: Lo mugqa umayelana nangeSonto; usuku lwakho ngoLwesithathu.
x-k-k1-07.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 2 no-3 isebenza kuzo zonke izinsuku ezijwayelekile. Umugqa 1 igama futhi umugqa 4 umayelana nangeSonto kuphela.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.prompt: Thola izikhathi ezintathu ezihlukile ngoLwesithathu lapho ungafika khona futhi umtapo wezincwadi uvuliwe. Isikhathi ngasinye ngu-'h:30'; faka ihora h ewashini lamahora angu-24 (1 p.m. = 13).
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala bhala amahora okuvula nokuvala njengezinombolo zamahora angu-24.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.hint.1: Susa ihora lokuphumula, bese uhlola izinombolo zakho.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Umtapo wezincwadi uvuliwe kusukela ku-9:00 kuya ku-18:00, ngakho h:30 kumele ibe phakathi kwalelo banga.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.explain: Izikhathi zokuvula ziyi-9:30 kuya ku-11:30 kanye no-13:30 kuya ku-17:30 njengezikhathi zokufika ze-h:30. 12:30 isekuphumuleni, futhi 8:30 no-18:30 ziphakathi kwamahora okuvala.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhalela umngani osho ukuthi 'uvuliwe kusukela ku-9 kuya ku-6, noma yisiphi isikhathi sihle' imisho eyodwa noma emibili yesiNgisi: yiziphi izikhathi eziyehluleka, futhi kungani?
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Yimuphi umugqa wophawu umngani wakho awushiyile?
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Umngani wami angakwazi manje ukuhlela ukuvakasha?
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Phakathi kuka-12 no-1 uyaphumula (쉬어요), futhi ngaphambi kuka-9 noma ngemva kuka-6 uvaliwe.
x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Ungeze ngesikhathi sasemini, 12 kuya ku-1. Umtapo wezincwadi unesikhathi sokuphumula ngaleso sikhathi, ngakho khetha esinye isikhathi phakathi kuka-9 no-6.

x-k-k1-02.title: Uma kuyana, ingabe i-picnic iyaqhubeka?
x-k-k1-02.goal: Qhathanisa inothi elibhalwe ngesiNgisi nesaziso sokuqala sesiKorea, uthole umugqa osho okungaphezu kwesaziso, bese ubhala umthetho wesiKorea wena ngokwakho.
x-k-k1-02.material:
Uthisha unamathisele isaziso emnyango wekilasi:

내일은 소풍 가요.
9시까지 학교에 오세요.
도시락을 가져오세요.
비가 오면 소풍을 안 가요.

Amagama: 소풍 = ohambo/i-picnic; 도시락 = ibhokisi lesidlo sasemini; 비 = imvula; 오다 = ukuza (비가 오다 = iyana); 안 = hhayi.

UJoon wasifunda wabhala amanothi amane esiNgisi (akhonjiswe ngezansi).

Amagama engeziwe (esinyathelweni 2): 눈 = iqhwa (눈이 오다 = kunamaqhwa); 공원 = ipaki.
x-k-k1-02.thinking.0: Ukuhlola isifinyezo umugqa ngomugqa ngokumelene nomthombo
x-k-k1-02.prereq.1: Usudibane nokuphela kwe-(으)면 nomqondo ka-'uma' emishweni elula
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.prompt: Elinye lamanothi kaJoon lisho okungaphezu kwalokho okushiwo yisaziso. Ngumuphi umugqa?
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qhathanisa inothi ngalinye nesaziso, umugqa ngomugqa.
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Yiliphi inothi elisho into njengeqinisekile isaziso esisho njengomsebenzi kuphela?
x-k-k1-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 4 uyinkinga. Isaziso sisho okwenzekayo uma kunetha (비가 오면); asisho ukuthi kuzonetha. UJoon waguqula isimo saba isibikezelo.
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.prompt: Elinye isaziso, esishiwo ngesiNgisi: "If it snows tomorrow, we do not go to the park." Bhala lo mthetho ngesiKorea (ulimi lwe--요 olunenhlonipho), usebenzisa amagama angenhla.

x-k-k1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi umusho wakho awusho ukuthi KUZOBA NEQHWA.
x-k-k1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Umusho wami uqukethe 'if it snows' hhayi 'it snows'?
